transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to knock out over the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each one needs a two-hour block. Our available windows are Monday 0800-1200, Tuesday 0800-1600, and Wednesday 0800-1200. We've got the training room, motor pool training bay, and safety classroom available unless something changes. Before I sign the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Training NCO, what's the status on forklift certification? Motor pool sergeant, where do we stand on the generator refresher? And safety officer, what do we have on the hazmat refresher?
